svg.title: MAST long-run activity clock
svg.desc: One revolution is 24 hours. Gold ticks mark completed spectra, orange arcs scans, gray arcs logged waits, small dots tip moves, dark diamonds local tip interventions, and open circles acquisitions resumed after a logged automatic retry. The approximately 99-hour span includes gaps and is not a claim of uninterrupted instrument operation. The completed log ends 2026-09-22 02:08:10 UTC+08:00.
